verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh can be operated fully headless through its own API. Scoped, expiring API credentials support non-interactive auth. Screening can run synchronously, asynchronously or through a Batch Processing API. Webhooks deliver results to programmatic consumers, and cases, alerts and risks can be remediated via the API instead of the web app. An OpenAPI schema and Postman collection support automated integration. missing for 10: a CLI or CI-specific tooling and guidance, a documented sandbox/test environment for pipeline runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation (the OpenAPI probe paths returned 404).
